name: 埃伯哈特
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_二_崛起下.md:164
who: Eberhard, a human master caster of forty-eight, a founder of lamps in the lower city's first-light street: about 174 cm, short and stocky, wide through the shoulders, with thick arms. A short beard of grey streaked with red, eyebrows half burned away by the furnace. Blue-grey eyes that squint as if reading the colour of molten brass. Forearms covered with old burn scars, and the tip of the little finger of his left hand missing (on the viewer's right when they face us). A gruff, patient, craftsman's air. No glasses. The little finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) ends above the last knuckle in a healed stump, so that finger is clearly shorter than the ring finger beside it in every panel where the hand shows; the right hand has all five fingers whole.
build: 174 cm, short and stocky, wide shoulders and very thick forearms.
palette: furnace orange, brass, soot grey, scorched leather brown
casual: A long leather apron pocked with many small burn holes, its brass buttons rubbed bright, over an undyed wool shirt with the sleeves always pushed above the elbow, dark trousers and heavy boots; a small hammer and a pair of tongs at his belt. He holds a brass lamp casting in his right hand; a gruff, steady look.
private: Home clothes: no apron, a loose undyed wool shirt open at the throat with the sleeves rolled, soft old trousers and shoes. He holds a small brass lamp against his chest in both arms; a quiet, tired smile.
battle: Ready to hold the street: the burn-holed leather apron strapped on, thick leather gloves to the elbow, a leather cap. He grips a heavy forging hammer in both hands, held across his body, feet planted wide; a hard, stubborn look.
formal: For the lamp-casters' feast: a clean grey wool coat fastened with big brass clasps over a fresh white shirt with an open neck, the beard combed, a new leather apron tied over it with one scorched corner kept as a mark of pride. He holds a small polished brass lamp before him whose flame burns cold white; a shy, proud smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the blue-grey eyes squinting a little at the viewer as if checking a colour, a faint smile. Orange furnace glow from one side, cool soot-grey dusk from the other. Foreground blur: drifting sparks and a molten drip of brass. He wears the burn-holed apron.

name: 伊尔泽
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_二_崛起下.md:220
who: Ilse, a human woman of twenty-seven, a hunter of the village on the outer slope of the north pass: tall, about 170 cm, lean and wiry from running the slopes. Dark green hair cut ear-length and tied back with a leather cord. A scatter of freckles, a high brow, dark gold eyes with wide pupils in the dark. A leather bracer on her left forearm (on the viewer's right when they face us) scored with bowstring marks. A quiet, watchful, tireless air.
build: 170 cm, lean and sinewy, long-legged: a B-cup bust, a trim waist and slim hips.
palette: dark green and copper-wolf brown, bone, dark gold
casual: A short coat of copper-colored wolf hide worn fur inward, over a plain wool shirt, dark leather trousers and soft hunting boots, a skinning knife at her belt, a quiver of arrows on her back. She holds a hard hunting bow upright in her right hand; a calm, wary look.
private: Resting clothes: a loose long-sleeved wool shirt, the sleeves rolled, a knitted brown vest, wool trousers, soft shoes, the cord loosened so her hair falls forward. She holds a coil of bowstring in both hands; a quiet, sleepy half-smile.
battle: Hunting the pack: the wolf-hide coat buttoned, a hood of the same pelt pulled up, leather gloves, the bracer tight. She draws the hard bow with an arrow nocked, the string at her cheek, feet wide; a fierce, calm look.
formal: For the village feast: a clean dark green wool dress with long sleeves and a white collar, the wolf-hide coat brushed and worn open over it, a neat ribbon tying her hair. She holds the bow upright at her side; a modest, steady smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait with the camera slightly low, the face large, the dark gold eyes looking at the viewer with wide, steady pupils, lips closed. Cold blue night light from one side, a warm campfire glow from the other. Foreground blur: drifting snowflakes and the fletching of an arrow. She wears the wolf-hide coat with the fur inward.

name: 鲁珀特
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_二_崛起下.md:276
who: Rupert, a human young man of nineteen, an academy apprentice at the tower's ring: tall, about 182 cm, thin and long-limbed, a hunter's-family frame that academy food never fills out. Untidy dark green hair that is always rumpled, dark gold eyes that open wide in the dark like his sister's. A face still a little round with boyhood, a few new hairs on the chin. A pale silver ring engraved inside with his name on the middle finger of his left hand (on the viewer's right when they face us). An eager, restless, clever air. No glasses.
build: 182 cm, tall and thin, long arms and narrow shoulders, not yet filled out.
palette: dark green and academy grey, wolf-fur brown, pale silver, dark gold
casual: An academy apprentice's grey wool robe with the sleeves a hand too short because he grows fast, over a thick home-sewn jacket lined with wolf fur at the neck, a rolled sheet of his own ring sketches at the belt, plain boots. He holds the left hand up to show the pale silver ring; an eager, boyish look.
private: Resting clothes: the grey robe off, only the thick home-sewn jacket with the wolf-fur collar over a loose wool shirt, soft trousers and shoes. He hugs a bundle of sketches under one arm; a sleepy, grinning look.
battle: Ready for the ring: the grey robe belted tight with the sleeves pushed back, the jacket under it, leather gloves on the right hand only. He holds both hands out in front of him, fingers spread, the ring on his left hand glinting; he carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the ring outfit: standing tall and braced, the feet a little apart, both hands held out in front of him with the fingers spread, the pale silver ring on the left hand glinting; he carries no weapon, a tense focused expression.
formal: For the academy's oath: the grey robe brushed, the cuffs lengthened with a clean band, the jacket left off, the ring on his left hand. He stands straight with his hands folded in front; a nervous, proud smile.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face a little tilted, the dark gold eyes wide open and bright, a quick eager smile. Cold white tower light from one side, warm lamp glow from the other. Foreground blur: pale silver rings drifting in the air and a rumpled sketch page. He wears the grey robe over the fur-collared jacket.

name: 阿德里安
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_二_崛起下.md:427
who: Adrian, a human man of twenty-three, the prince of the besieged Golden Crown city, a knight of the Sun: tall, about 188 cm, broad-shouldered, long-armed. Short light gold hair that looks like the roof of the crown hall at sunrise. Orange-gold eyes that look first at the door behind you. A thin scar across the left brow (on the viewer's right when they face us), from an arrow that grazed him in the second year of the siege. A fang shows when he smiles, though he has smiled less since. A loyal, grave, weary air. No glasses.
build: 188 cm, tall and broad, long arms, a strong frame built for holding a shield through a long night.
palette: white and gold, sunrise gold, orange-gold, weathered steel
casual: A Sun knight's white plate armour, the edge of every plate once inlaid with gold, much of it scraped off bit by bit to pay for medicine, so only a faint gold line remains; a white tabard with a plain sun disc, a white cloak. He holds a round shield whose gold face is scratched and worn dull on his left arm; a grave, steady look.
private: Off duty: a loose white linen shirt, a plain grey wool jerkin, dark trousers and soft boots, the armour off. He folds his arms loosely and the scar shows; a tired, gentle half-smile.
battle: Ready to hold the wall: the worn white plate with its scraped gold edging, a white cloak torn at the hem, steel gauntlets. He holds the sun shield on his left arm braced forward, and a long royal sword in his right hand pointed down, feet planted wide; a hard, immovable look.
formal: For the crown hall: the white plate polished, a clean white surcoat with a gold sun disc, a long white cloak pinned with a gold sun brooch, the royal sword at his belt. He stands upright; a noble, grave look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the orange-gold eyes looking at the viewer with a steady, weary look, lips closed. Warm sunrise gold from one side lighting his hair, cold grey smoke-light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting embers and a scratched gold shield rim. He wears the worn white plate.

name: 希奥
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_二_崛起下.md:483
who: Theo, a wolf-eared man of twenty-five, a courier of the wolf-ear hunting grounds: tall, about 185 cm, thin, long-legged. Short grey hair, and two grey wolf ears that lie flat against his head when the wind blows, with no separate human ears. Amber eyes that look first at which way the wind is blowing. A narrow face with high cheekbones and lips always chapped. A swift, quiet, carrying-only-what-matters air. No glasses.
build: 185 cm, tall and thin, long-legged, wiry.
palette: wolf grey and brass, wolfskin brown, amber
casual: A short wolfskin vest over a plain wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, wolfskin leg wraps over dark trousers and light boots, a brass message tube on his belt with a wooden stopper he whittled himself. Nothing else. He holds a hand out flat as if testing the wind; a quiet, alert look.
private: Resting clothes: a loose wool shirt with the sleeves rolled, soft trousers, soft shoes, the leg wraps off. He holds a cloth of dried meat; a sleepy, closed-mouth look, the ears drooping.
battle: On the run: the wolfskin vest buttoned, a short hood of wolf fur over his ears, leather gloves, the leg wraps pulled tight, the brass tube strapped to his chest. He leans forward in a sprinting stance with one arm swung back; a fierce, determined look. He carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the courier's outfit: leaning forward in a sprinting stance, the feet apart, one arm swung back and the other hand gripping the strap of the brass message tube; he carries no weapon, a fierce determined expression.
formal: For delivering to the king: a clean grey wool jacket with a high collar over a white shirt, the wolfskin vest brushed, the leg wraps neat, the brass tube polished at his belt. He stands upright with his hands at his sides; a polite, composed look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face turned into the wind, the amber eyes looking at the viewer, the ears pressed back, lips closed. Cold white light of a snowfield from one side, warm gold dawn on the other. Foreground blur: swirling snow and the brass tube. He wears the wolfskin vest.

name: 卡西安
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_二_崛起下.md:539
who: Cassian, a human man of fifty-two, commander of the eastern legion: tall, about 180 cm, thin, his back straight. Short grey-white hair, a clean-shaven, hollow-cheeked face, grey-green eyes that look at people slowly, as if reading a letter. A pale silver ring engraved inside with his name on the middle finger of his right hand (on the viewer's left when they face us), the fingertips stained with ink. A calm, patient, letter-writing air. No glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean man's face of about fifty-two, hollow cheeks, fine lines at the eyes and mouth, grey-green slow eyes with a patient gaze, thin grey-white eyebrows, a clean-shaven jaw; skin shadows a cool tone.
build: 180 cm, thin and straight, long hands, a rider's lean frame.
palette: legion grey-blue and pale silver, ink black, grey-green
casual: The eastern legion's commander: a grey-blue cloak with a worn embroidered ring of fire crossed by two keys on the chest, over plain grey legion armour, boots; no sword. A leather letter pouch at his hip holding unfinished letters. He holds a folded letter in his right hand; a slow, thoughtful look.
private: Resting clothes: a loose grey wool shirt, a plain dark wool jerkin, soft trousers and shoes, no cloak, the ring on his right hand. He holds a folded letter against his chest; a tired, gentle look.
battle: Ready to command: the grey legion armour with fine bone-silver rune-lines running along every plate edge, the grey-blue cloak with the ring-of-fire and crossed-keys emblem embroidered on the chest, gauntlets, a legion short sword at his belt, the letter pouch slung across the chest, the pale silver name ring faintly lit. He stands upright with one gloved hand extended in a command; a calm, stern look.
formal: For receiving the king: the grey-blue cloak brushed, the legion armour polished, a clean white shirt collar, the ring on his hand showing. He holds a sealed letter in both hands in front of him; a grave, courteous look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the grey-green eyes looking at the viewer slowly as if reading, lips closed. Cold grey morning light from one side, a warm lamp glow from the other. Foreground blur: the corner of an unfinished letter and a pale silver ring. He wears the grey-blue cloak with its worn emblem.

name: 贝伦加
src: 萨尔维斯/萨尔维斯时段_二_崛起下.md:803
who: Berengar, a human man of forty-five, the last king of the Sun kingdom: tall, a little stout, about 185 cm. A neat beard of light gold, orange-gold eyes like his son's, a face full of laugh lines. He laughs easily, even when the tendons of his neck stand out under the weight of the crown. A warm, talkative, fatherly air that calls everyone child. No glasses.
face: FACE, as in the references: a warm man's face of about forty-five, full cheeks, deep laugh lines at the eyes, orange-gold kindly eyes, a neat light gold beard, thick light eyebrows; skin shadows a warm tone.
build: 185 cm, tall and stout, broad soft shoulders and a heavy chest.
palette: white and sun gold, warm cream, orange-gold
casual: A king's plain white wool robe to the knee with a gold-edged hem over a cream tunic and dark trousers, a gold sun-disc pin at the collar, a heavy white cloak, soft boots; no crown. He holds both hands open in front of him, laughing; a warm, kind look.
private: Resting clothes: a soft old cream wool robe open over a loose shirt, slippers, a thick knitted shawl. He holds a heel of bread; a gentle, tired laugh.
battle: Resolved for the last night: a white surcoat with a gold sun disc over a mail shirt, a white cloak, leather gloves; the crown removed and held out in his right hand. His left hand rests on the hilt of a sheathed king's sword at his belt; a calm, resolved smile.
formal: Crowned: the white robe with gold edging and an old plain band of gold with a sun disc at the front on his head, a long white cloak. He stands tall, the neck tendons taut, still smiling.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the face large, the orange-gold eyes looking at the viewer with kind eyes and a warm laugh, lips closed. Warm sunrise gold from one side, cold grey smoke-light from the other. Foreground blur: drifting embers and the blurred edge of a gold crown. He wears the white robe.
